## Operational Notes

- Incident submissions require server-validated coordinates; public coordinates are revealed only through the H3 k-anonymity policy.
- SOS exact location/trail disclosure is backend-only and audited; clients never receive private Firestore collection access.
- Firebase callable names are exported from `functions/src/index.js`; deploy with the `pulsetrackr-sos` functions codebase.
